name: gptmd-memory
description: Local memory, durable persistence, and evidence-based self-improvement for Codex projects.

interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex plugin that recalls project knowledge, records durable decisions and lessons, and turns verified failures into reusable guidance without committing or modifying application source.
defaultPrompt: Recall the relevant project decisions before coding.
Record this decision as durable project knowledge.
Capture the verified lesson from this failure.
